ca16d602590b56.s: India has about ____ of the world’s freshwater and about ____ of the world’s population.
ca16d602590b56.x: India possesses about 4% of the world’s freshwater but about 17% of its population; the reversed figures are a common trap.

cabf915b565962.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Blue carbon – Mangroves, seagrass and salt marshes
Mangroves – Store 3–5 times less carbon per hectare than tropical forests
cabf915b565962.x: Mangroves store 3–5 times MORE carbon per hectare than tropical forests, so that pair is wrong; the other three pairs are correct.

ca642462b40b5c.s: India’s updated NDC expresses its emissions target in terms of:
ca642462b40b5c.x: India uses emissions intensity rather than absolute emissions for its NDC target; the non-fossil share (about 52.6% in early 2026) is a separate indicator.

ca14c06f7abd67.s: Lipulekh Pass, a route for the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra, lies at an altitude of about:
ca14c06f7abd67.x: Lipulekh Pass is at about 5,334 m and is a Kailash Mansarovar Yatra route; Nathu La and Shipki La are other India–China trade passes.

cab1b6b80e5fe9.s: A tiger was camera-trapped in D’Ering Memorial Wildlife Sanctuary, Arunachal Pradesh, for the first time in nearly:
cab1b6b80e5fe9.x: The tiger was camera-trapped in D’Ering Memorial Wildlife Sanctuary for the first time in nearly two decades.

cada1a8d745ddb.s: A Zoological Survey of India study produced India’s first COI-gene DNA barcode library for which group?
cada1a8d745ddb.x: The ZSI study on Indian cockroach diversity created India’s first DNA barcode library for cockroaches, based on the COI gene.

cabbb4739b3bd3.s: Urtan in Madhya Pradesh became India’s first ____ coal mine to start production under the commercial coal auction regime.
cabbb4739b3bd3.x: Urtan, allocated to JMS Mining Pvt Ltd, was India’s first underground coal mine to start production under commercial coal auctions.

cacde927dcc6fb.s: The Environment Protection Act, 1986 was enacted under which Article of the Constitution?
cacde927dcc6fb.x: Article 253 lets Parliament legislate to implement international treaties and agreements; the EP Act, 1986 was enacted under it.

ca5e986552d11f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The secretariat of the International Big Cat Alliance is in Geneva.
2. The New Delhi Declaration is the first international declaration exclusively on rhinoceroses.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca5e986552d11f.x: Both are wrong: the IBCA secretariat is in India, and the New Delhi Declaration is meant to be the first declaration exclusively on big cats.

ca8d2aa40958a9.s: The first international conference on transition away from fossil fuels (April 24–29, 2026) was scheduled at:
ca8d2aa40958a9.x: The conference was scheduled at Santa Marta, Colombia, with participation from more than 50 countries.

ca473a81b15137.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
ca473a81b15137.x: The Asiatic lion is Panthera leo persica; the Bengal tiger is Panthera tigris tigris, the Indian leopard Panthera pardus fusca and the snow leopard Panthera uncia.

ca15034cb9a85c.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Zoological Survey of India was established in 1916 and the Botanical Survey of India in 1890.
2. The Zoological Survey of India is headquartered in Chennai.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca15034cb9a85c.x: ZSI (1916) and BSI (1890) are both headquartered in Kolkata; Chennai hosts the National Biodiversity Authority.

ca541cc9cd19c2.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Antarctic Treaty was signed in 1959 and entered into force in 1961.
2. The Chicxulub crater is located in Wyoming.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca541cc9cd19c2.x: Statement 1 is correct. The 66-million-year-old Chicxulub crater is in Mexico, not Wyoming.

ca394d65678137.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Sukhna Wildlife Sanctuary in Chandigarh lies in the Shivalik foothills and was established in 1998.
2. Eco-sensitive zones are declared under the Environment Protection Act, 1986.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca394d65678137.x: Both are correct: Sukhna WLS (1998) is in the Shivalik foothills, and eco-sensitive zones are notified under the EP Act, 1986.

cab474e00751e9.s:
Consider the following statements about Project Cheetah:
1. Phase I (September 2022) brought 8 cheetahs from Namibia.
2. Phase II (February 2023) brought 12 cheetahs from South Africa.
3. Phase III (2026) brought 9 cheetahs from South Africa.
Which of the above statements are correct?
cab474e00751e9.x: Phases I and II are correctly described; Phase III in 2026 sourced 9 cheetahs from Botswana, not South Africa.

ca869c0373bda1.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
ca869c0373bda1.x: IUCN (1948) is headquartered at Gland. INTERPOL (1923) is at Lyon, while the WCO (1952) is at Brussels.

ca82fc2eb80f54.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Gir National Park was established in 1965.
2. The Asiatic lion (Panthera leo persica) is listed as Vulnerable by the IUCN.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca82fc2eb80f54.x: Gir National Park was established in 1965; the Asiatic lion, Panthera leo persica, is classified as Endangered, not Vulnerable.

ca5fbdd9693197.s: Which of the following pairs (species discoveries, May 2026) is correctly matched?
o: Labeo kaage – Named after Prof. H. T. Lalremsanga
ca5fbdd9693197.x: Trachischium lalremsangai is an insect-eating snake named after Prof. H. T. Lalremsanga; Labeo kaage is the fish ‘Kaage Meenu’ reported by ICAR–NBFGR.

cafe6515f11516.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Papikonda National Park?
o: It extends across East and West Godavari.
It was designated a National Park in 2008.
It is officially a Tiger Reserve.
Explorer was released there on 14 February 2026.
cafe6515f11516.x: Papikonda is a National Park, not an officially notified Tiger Reserve; the other statements are correct.

ca8cbacfdbfb3e.s: In the ‘jumpstart’ method used for a Great Indian Bustard chick at Naiya grassland, Kutch:
o: A wild female’s fertile egg was swapped for an infertile one and the captive centre raised the chick
A wild female’s infertile egg was replaced with a fertile egg from a Rajasthan captive centre, and the wild mother raised the chick
A chick reared in a captive centre was released directly into the grassland
A fertile wild egg was taken to Rajasthan, hatched there and the chick returned to Kutch
ca8cbacfdbfb3e.x: The infertile egg of a wild female was replaced with a fertile egg from a Rajasthan captive centre, and the wild mother raised the chick.

cac84068af4a82.s: Which of the following species–place pairs is correctly matched?
o: Stauranthera aureoglossa – Near Raimona National Park, Kokrajhar
cac84068af4a82.x: Limnonectes motijheel was found in Namdapha Tiger Reserve; Cyrtodactylus raimonaensis is from near Raimona NP, Stauranthera aureoglossa from Kamle and Upper Subansiri, and Megalopinus arunachalensis from Arunachal Pradesh.

cab42bf6e5a7f7.s: India’s first national report on bats (2024–25) was prepared jointly by:
o: ZSI, Botanical Survey of India and Bat Conservation International
ZSI, Central Water Commission and Nature Conservation Foundation
Botanical Survey of India, Nature Conservation Foundation and Bat Conservation International
Zoological Survey of India, Nature Conservation Foundation and Bat Conservation International
cab42bf6e5a7f7.x: The report was prepared by the Zoological Survey of India, Nature Conservation Foundation and Bat Conservation International.

cab34998cba4d0.s: Which of the following pairs about India’s Ramsar sites is correctly matched?
o: Vembannur Wetland Complex – Largest Ramsar site
cab34998cba4d0.x: Sundarbans is India’s largest Ramsar site; Vembannur Wetland Complex is now the smallest (Renuka held that position earlier), and Chilika was among the first sites.

caa3d4b0e70a9e.s: Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve, from which Explorer originated, is located in which district?
caa3d4b0e70a9e.x: Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve is in Chandrapur district and is named after Tadoba Lake and the Andhari River.

cae1402d4db5d3.s:
Consider the following statements about the Great Indian Bustard (Ardeotis nigriceps):
1. It is listed in Schedule II of the Wildlife Protection Act and Appendix II of CITES.
2. It is Critically Endangered on the IUCN Red List.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cae1402d4db5d3.x: The Great Indian Bustard is IUCN Critically Endangered and is in WPA Schedule I and CITES Appendix I (also CMS), not Schedule II/Appendix II.

caa51baae222a1.s: The Great Indian Bustard, a bird of arid and semi-arid grasslands, is the State bird of:
caa51baae222a1.x: The Great Indian Bustard is the State bird of Rajasthan and inhabits arid and semi-arid grasslands.

ca089e517e3e74.s: Captive-breeding centres for the Great Indian Bustard at Ramdevra and Sam are in which district?
ca089e517e3e74.x: Captive breeding of the Great Indian Bustard is done at Ramdevra and Sam in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan.

ca3fba4eb1e348.s:
Consider the following statements about India’s first national report on bats (2024–25):
1. India has 135 bat species.
2. Of these, 7 species are endemic.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca3fba4eb1e348.x: India has 135 bat species, of which 16 are endemic and 7 are IUCN Threatened; statement 2 swaps these figures.

ca5d217af2b553.s: Which of the following species–place pairs is correctly matched?
o: Chhapgarus ngankeeae – Manas National Park, Assam
Osbeckia zubeengargiana – Near Ziro Valley, Arunachal Pradesh
ca5d217af2b553.x: Gichak nakna was found in western Assam; Chhapgarus ngankeeae is from Goa mangroves, Actinidia indica from near Ziro Valley and Osbeckia zubeengargiana from Manas NP.

cae1b8e1dc5421.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the National Beekeeping and Honey Mission?
o: It is a Central Sector Scheme linked to the ‘Sweet Revolution’.
It is implemented by the National Bee Board under the Ministry of Environment.
Its outlay is ₹500 crore for FY 2020–21 to 2025–26.
It is implemented by the National Bee Board.
cae1b8e1dc5421.x: The National Bee Board implements the Mission under the Ministry of Agriculture, not the Ministry of Environment.

ca50a7bc5d0397.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026?
o: They replace the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016.
They emphasise source segregation, landfill reduction and legacy dumpsite remediation.
They came into force on 1 April 2025.
They extend duties to rural local bodies, including Gram Panchayats.
ca50a7bc5d0397.x: The Rules came into force on 1 April 2026, not 1 April 2025; the other statements are correct.

cae2ff4c48ec5a.s:
Consider the following statements about the River Basin Management Scheme:
1. It treats the whole river system, including tributaries, floodplains, groundwater and wetlands, as one hydrological unit.
2. It is fully centrally funded.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cae2ff4c48ec5a.x: Both are correct: the scheme uses an integrated hydrological-unit approach and is fully centrally funded.

cada8efed4a12b.s: The four-way segregation of waste under the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 is into:
o: Wet, dry, sanitary and special domestic hazardous
cada8efed4a12b.x: The four categories are wet, dry, sanitary and special domestic hazardous waste.

caac28cf0f2a26.s:
Consider the following statements about the Forest Survey of India’s Anavaran portal:
1. It has operated since January 2024.
2. It sends forest-cover-loss alerts to States every 15 days.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caac28cf0f2a26.x: Both are correct: Anavaran has run since January 2024 and uses satellite and machine-learning detection to alert States every 15 days.

ca724ad2e6f32d.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The US Climate Prediction Center gave a 51% chance of El Niño during May–July 2026.
2. A Western Disturbance is an east-moving rain system originating beyond Afghanistan and Iran.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca724ad2e6f32d.x: The forecast chance of El Niño was 61%, not 51%; statement 2 correctly describes a Western Disturbance.

ca41bd325b49bb.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Sustained wet-bulb temperature above 35°C can be fatal.
2. Feels-like temperature is calculated from temperature, pressure and wind.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca41bd325b49bb.x: Statement 1 is correct; apparent (feels-like) temperature combines temperature, humidity and wind, not pressure.

cac40715d213e4.s: Climate change has contributed to dengue spreading into which non-traditional areas of India?
o: Shimla and parts of Jammu and Kashmir
cac40715d213e4.x: Dengue has been reported spreading to non-traditional areas such as Shimla and parts of Jammu and Kashmir.

cac143d182bdc1.s: Which of the following GI-tagged product–State pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
cac143d182bdc1.x: Navara Rice is a GI product of Kerala, not Karnataka; the other three pairs are correct.

ca81b19fd8282e.s:
Consider the following statements about Oil India Limited:
1. It was established in 1959.
2. It is headquartered at Duliajan, Assam.
3. It functions under the Ministry of Coal.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca81b19fd8282e.x: Oil India Limited (1959) is headquartered at Duliajan, Assam, and functions under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, not the Ministry of Coal.

cabc8e325e1f42.s: Which body declared the Yana Caves near Gokarna (Uttara Kannada) a national Geo-heritage site on April 13, 2026?
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
cabc8e325e1f42.x: The Geological Survey of India declared the Yana Caves a national Geo-heritage site on April 13, 2026.

ca711f97eef075.s:
Consider the following statements about the Yana Caves:
1. They lie in the Eastern Ghats.
2. They were formed through tectonic and volcanic processes.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca711f97eef075.x: Both are wrong: the about 2,700-million-year-old Yana Caves lie in the Western Ghats and were formed through tectonic and karst processes.

ca287ff25f7c61.s: The Geological Survey of India, which declares national Geo-heritage sites, was established in:
ca287ff25f7c61.x: The Geological Survey of India was established in 1851.

ca44246df3ebcf.s: Which garden in Srinagar is recognised as Asia’s largest tulip garden?
ca44246df3ebcf.x: The Indira Gandhi Memorial Tulip Garden, at the foothills of the Zabarwan Range by Dal Lake, is Asia’s largest tulip garden.

cad395931e40c1.s:
Consider the following statements about Manas National Park:
1. It was declared a World Heritage Site in 1985.
2. It was designated a Biosphere Reserve in 2008.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cad395931e40c1.x: Manas became a World Heritage Site in 1985 and a Biosphere Reserve in 1989, not 2008.

caf29efb66e045.s: Which Kerala locality was included in the first list of “20 Cities Towards Zero Waste”?
caf29efb66e045.x: Varkala was in the first list of “20 Cities Towards Zero Waste”, an initiative led by the UN Secretary-General’s Advisory Board on Zero Waste with UN-Habitat and UNEP support.

ca66ffdf9947a1.s: After 12 new sites were added in April 2026, the total number of UNESCO Global Geoparks rose to:
ca66ffdf9947a1.x: The 12 additions raised the total to 241 UNESCO Global Geoparks across 51 countries.

cabc4264445d02.s: Under the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026, an entity generating more than ____ of waste per day can be classed as a bulk waste generator.
cabc4264445d02.x: One bulk-generator threshold is more than 100 kg of waste per day; such generators must process waste on site.

ca2f7dbf46ecb3.s: The pilot project in Amrabad Tiger Reserve converts invasive Lantana camara into which product, called ‘black gold’?
ca2f7dbf46ecb3.x: The Amrabad pilot converts invasive Lantana camara into biocharcoal, described as ‘black gold’.

ca917c57e5c088.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Aushadhi Vanaspati Mitra programme is associated with medicinal plants.
2. Cultivation of medicinal plants is now covered under MIDH.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca917c57e5c088.x: Both are correct: Aushadhi Vanaspati Mitra concerns medicinal plants, whose cultivation is now covered under MIDH.

ca37933d4ffb29.s:
Consider the following statements about improved cookstoves:
1. Secondary aeration results in fuller combustion.
2. They reduce indoor pollution but do not eliminate it.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca37933d4ffb29.x: Both are correct: secondary aeration gives fuller combustion, and improved cookstoves reduce but do not eliminate indoor pollution.

ca20412af63edd.s: In photochemical smog, which pollutants react in sunlight to produce ozone and PAN?
ca20412af63edd.x: Nitrogen oxides and volatile organic compounds react in sunlight to form the secondary pollutants ozone and PAN.

ca261285152817.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Mekong Delta – Rises in the Tibetan Plateau as the Lancang
Tonle Sap Lake – Rice bowl of Southeast Asia
Tonle Sap Lake – Seasonal flow reversal
Dysprosium – Rice bowl of Southeast Asia
ca261285152817.x: Tonle Sap Lake shows seasonal flow reversal; the Mekong rises as the Lancang, the Mekong Delta is the rice bowl of Southeast Asia, and dysprosium is used in NdFeB magnets.

ca8064c97f2180.s:
Consider the following statements about the Mekong River Commission:
1. It was established in 1995.
2. China, Myanmar, Laos and Vietnam are its four full members.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca8064c97f2180.x: The MRC was set up in 1995; its full members are Cambodia, Laos, Thailand and Vietnam, while China and Myanmar are dialogue partners.

ca738ba76e35f3.s: Which of the following species–habitat pairs is correctly matched?
o: Mogrus shushka – Desert areas of Rajasthan and Gujarat
Corononema dhruti – Urban biodiversity parks of Maharashtra
Dillenia nagalim – Off the Tamil Nadu coast
ca738ba76e35f3.x: Mogrus shushka is from desert areas of Rajasthan and Gujarat; Mogrus pune is from Maharashtra’s urban biodiversity parks, Corononema dhruti from off the Tamil Nadu coast, and Dillenia nagalim from Kamjong, Manipur.

caf3ddc51a21a4.s: Both UN-Habitat and UNEP are headquartered in:
caf3ddc51a21a4.x: UN-Habitat and UNEP both have their headquarters in Nairobi.

caba4c0f67a4fb.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Nagauri Ashwagandha received a GI tag in 2025.
2. TRAFFIC is not a UNEP bureau.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caba4c0f67a4fb.x: Both are correct: Nagauri Ashwagandha got a GI tag in 2025, and TRAFFIC is not a UNEP bureau.

cad52683184f6c.s: Which ENSO phase is associated with relatively warm ocean conditions?
cad52683184f6c.x: El Niño is the warm phase of ENSO; La Niña is the cool phase and Neutral is neither.

caf9d3f2b6a514.s: Which State was considering treating bee attacks as a state-notified disaster?
caf9d3f2b6a514.x: Uttar Pradesh was considering bee attacks as a state-notified disaster; Gujarat and Maharashtra only reported bee-attack deaths.

ca73a37b686be6.s: The waggle dance of honeybees was decoded by which Nobel laureate?
ca73a37b686be6.x: Karl von Frisch decoded the honeybee waggle dance and received the Nobel Prize.

ca71ae89a7841c.s: The Panama Canal was completed in:
ca71ae89a7841c.x: The Panama Canal was completed in August 1914; 1999 marks its handover to Panama and 2016 its Neo-Panamax locks.

ca785e18f25e7e.s: The trial export of GI-tagged Karbi Anglong ginger from Assam was sent to:
ca785e18f25e7e.x: The 1.2 MT trial consignment of Karbi Anglong ginger went to London; Joha rice went to the UK and Italy.

ca96d53be759dc.s: India’s rank in the World Press Freedom Index 2026 (Reporters Without Borders) was:
ca96d53be759dc.x: India ranked 157th of 180 countries in 2026, down from 151st in 2025.

cadabcbb16e945.s: Which was the only Indian institution in the top 50 of the THE Asia University Rankings 2026?
cadabcbb16e945.x: IISc, ranked 43rd, was the only Indian institution in the top 50; Tsinghua, Peking and NUS took the top three places.

cab9b90282bb10.s:
Consider the following statements about the report Women and Men in India 2025:
1. The literacy gap was 14.4 percentage points.
2. Gender parity was achieved at all school levels except the primary level.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cab9b90282bb10.x: The literacy gap was 14.4 points, and gender parity was recorded at all school levels from primary to higher secondary, including primary.

cafd76bd9bef2e.s: In the World Press Freedom Index 2026, more than half of all countries fell in which categories?
cafd76bd9bef2e.x: More than 50% of countries were in the “Difficult” or “Very Serious” categories, with conditions worsening in about 100 countries.

cad27eb5c3965c.s: With reference to the IMF nominal GDP rankings for 2025, which pair is correctly matched?
cad27eb5c3965c.x: The 2025 order was USA 1st, China 2nd, Germany 3rd and Japan 4th.

ca9d0e26325956.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India ranked second in pulses.
2. India ranked first in milk.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca9d0e26325956.x: India ranked first in both pulses and milk, so only statement 2 is correct.

cadc0dff8e5bb5.s:
Consider the following statements about the ILO report on work-related stress:
1. It estimated about 840,000 deaths each year.
2. It estimated a loss of about 2.5% of global GDP.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cadc0dff8e5bb5.x: The ILO estimated about 840,000 deaths a year and a loss of 1.37% of global GDP, not 2.5%.

caefd6df4df973.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India was ranked 6th in the Global Terrorism Index 2026.
2. Pakistan was the most polluted country in the IQAir World Air Quality Report 2025.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caefd6df4df973.x: India was 13th in the Global Terrorism Index 2026 (6th was its IQAir rank); Pakistan was the most polluted country in IQAir 2025.

nba0d80f829b.s: The World Happiness Report is produced by the Wellbeing Research Centre, Oxford, with Gallup and:
nba0d80f829b.x: The report comes from Oxford’s Wellbeing Research Centre in collaboration with Gallup and the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network. (A sequence question needs dated items, so this is written as a one-liner.)

n7ad42fcf2b0.s: Which country topped the World Happiness Report 2026?
n7ad42fcf2b0.x: Finland topped the report for the ninth consecutive year, followed by Iceland and Denmark.

ca509dfae807c5.s: Which institution was the nodal agency for NFHS-6 (2023–24)?
ca509dfae807c5.x: IIPS, Mumbai, was the nodal agency for NFHS-6; the survey is conducted for the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

ca2a3854b9d663.s: Which of the following changes reported in NFHS-6 is NOT correct?
ca2a3854b9d663.x: Severe wasting declined from 7.7% to 5.2%; it did not rise.

cacfd028c97f10.s:
Consider the following statements about the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006:
1. The legal age of marriage for women is 21 years.
2. The legal age of marriage for men is 21 years.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cacfd028c97f10.x: Under the 2006 Act the legal age of marriage is 18 years for women and 21 years for men.

ca3d0b586c884b.s: Who released the 27th edition of Women and Men in India 2025?
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Women and Child Development
ca3d0b586c884b.x: The 27th edition of Women and Men in India 2025 was released by MoSPI.

cafb9af87ac25a.s: According to Women and Men in India 2025, the sex ratio at birth rose from 904 (2017–19) to ____ (2021–23).
cafb9af87ac25a.x: The sex ratio at birth improved from 904 in 2017–19 to 917 in 2021–23.

ca512a0dca70a8.s: Which NFHS-6 indicator–value pair is correctly matched?
ca512a0dca70a8.x: Rotavirus coverage was 85.4%; full immunisation was 87.1%, family health insurance 60.2% and women using the internet 64.3%.

cad27751dd2f1a.s: Between NFHS-5 and NFHS-6, first-trimester registration of pregnancies rose from 70% to:
cad27751dd2f1a.x: First-trimester registration increased from 70% to 76.2%. (The original two statements simply contradicted each other, so this is written as a one-liner.)

caba9ed2f54429.s:
With reference to Telangana in the NITI Aayog Fiscal Health Index 2023–24, consider the following statements:
1. Own tax revenue made up 80% of its revenue.
2. Its debt was ₹5.17 lakh crore.
3. Its fiscal deficit fell from 3.33% to 3.29%.
Which of the above statements are correct?
caba9ed2f54429.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; Telangana’s fiscal deficit rose from 3.29% to 3.33%, it did not fall.

ca0036bddfd352.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. A UN report found that in about 70% of countries, women have 64% of men’s legal rights.
2. UNESCO’s GEM Report 2026 recorded enrolment of 1.4 billion and projected 95% completion by 2105.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca0036bddfd352.x: Both are correct: the women’s access-to-justice report gave the 70%/64% finding, and the GEM Report 2026 gave 1.4 billion enrolment and 95% completion by 2105.

caa44386416537.s:
Consider the following statements about PLFS 2025:
1. 70.7% of rural women workers were self-employed.
2. 50.9% of urban women workers were self-employed.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caa44386416537.x: 70.7% of rural women were self-employed, while 50.9% of urban women were in regular wage jobs, not self-employment.

ca9eff73460caa.s: PLFS 2025, conducted by the NSO, was the first PLFS to provide:
o: Quarterly coverage of urban areas only
Monthly coverage of both rural and urban areas
Monthly coverage of urban areas only
Annual coverage of rural areas only
ca9eff73460caa.x: PLFS 2025 was the first edition with monthly coverage of both rural and urban areas; PLFS itself was launched in 2017.

ca76e2122c2565.s: The Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises (ASUSE) recorded how many enterprises in 2025?
ca76e2122c2565.x: ASUSE recorded 7.92 crore unincorporated enterprises; 12.81 crore is the number of persons employed in the non-agricultural sector.

cadc4506391e61.s:
Consider the following statements about the Tech Funding FY26 report:
1. It was published by the International Labour Organization.
